title: 「If so ／ If not」承接前文情況
titleZh: 「If so ／ If not」承接前文情況
titleEn: Using “If so / If not” to refer back to a situation

source.file: Sentence Structure 260 -「If so _ If not」承接前文情況.pdf
omissions: Every numbered Important Rule and Benefit is retained as a separate Chinese-primary card. Where the PDF does not provide a complete English counterpart, the English text is a faithful editorial translation.

formula: Statement or question. If so, + complete clause.

formulas.formula: Statement or question. If so, + complete clause.
Statement or question. If not, + complete clause.
Statement or question. If so, + outcome A; if not, + outcome B.
Verb + whether-clause + and, if so / if not, + action.

meaning.zh: If so 表示 if that is true / if that is the case；if not 表示 if that is not true / if that is not the case。兩者承接前文整個情況，避免重複完整條件。

rules.zh: 本課固定核心只有 if so 和 if not。逗號、分號、and、問詞和後續子句只是句法外殼或補充內容。
rules.en: The fixed core expressions are only if so and if not. Commas, semicolons, and, question words and following clauses are grammatical frames or additional content.

rules.zh: so 代替前文整個肯定情況，而不是單一名詞或形容詞。
rules.en: So replaces the whole affirmative situation stated earlier, not a single noun or adjective.

rules.zh: not 代替前述情況的否定形式，例如 If not 可表示 if the report is not ready。
rules.en: Not represents the negative form of the preceding situation; for example, If not can stand for if the report is not ready.

rules.zh: 前文必須清楚，讓讀者知道 so 或 not 代替哪個情況，也要避免不清楚的代名詞指涉。
rules.en: The preceding context must be clear so that the reader knows which situation so or not replaces, and pronoun references must also be unambiguous.

rules.zh: 表示結果的 so 意味「因此」，前述情況已成立；if so 意味「如果情況確實如此」，前述情況仍未確定。
rules.en: Result so means therefore and follows an established fact; if so means if that is true and follows a situation that remains uncertain.

rules.zh: 即使前文是否定句也可用 if so；此時 so 代替整個前述意思，包括 not。
rules.en: If so can refer back even to a negative statement; in that case, so replaces the entire preceding idea, including not.

rules.zh: If not 直接否定前面提出的情況；otherwise 通常表示如果不採取某行動便會有另一結果，兩者不能隨意互換。
rules.en: If not directly negates the preceding situation, whereas otherwise often states the result of not taking an action. They are not always interchangeable.

rules.zh: if so 和 if not 可放在新句開頭，後面通常加逗號；也可放在分號後連接關係密切的部分。
rules.en: If so and if not may begin a new sentence and are normally followed by a comma; they may also follow a semicolon joining closely related parts.

rules.zh: 它們可作句中插入語，例如 and, if so, + action；and 和逗號只是把表達嵌入較長句子的方式。
rules.en: They may be inserted within a longer sentence, as in and, if so, + action. And and the commas are simply the grammatical frame.

rules.zh: if so 和 if not 可連接兩個相反安排，清楚顯示情況成立和不成立時分別採取的行動。
rules.en: If so and if not can link two contrasting arrangements, showing what to do if the situation is true and what to do if it is not.

rules.zh: 後面可接完整問句或簡短問詞，例如 If so, when ...? 或 If not, why not?；這些是後續問題，不是固定表達的一部分。
rules.en: They may be followed by a complete question or a short question phrase, such as If so, when ...? or If not, why not? These are follow-up questions, not part of the fixed expression.

rules.zh: 後續子句的時態或情態動詞由真正意思決定；if so 和 if not 本身不規定使用 can、should、will、would 等哪一個形式。
rules.en: The tense or modal in the following clause depends on the intended meaning. If so and if not do not themselves determine whether to use can, should, will, would or another form.

rules.zh: 兩者一般承接尚未確定的情況；如果前文已用 definitely 表示完全確定，通常不再需要 if so。
rules.en: They normally refer back to an uncertain situation. If the previous statement already presents the situation as definite, if so is usually unnecessary.

benefits.zh: 以 if so 或 if not 代替完整條件，可以避免重複整個條件和名詞，使句子更簡潔。
benefits.en: They avoid repeating an entire condition and its nouns, making the sentence more concise.

benefits.zh: 兩者能清楚分開情況成立和不成立時的不同結果，讓讀者立即知道兩種安排。
benefits.en: They clearly separate two possible outcomes, showing what happens if a situation is true and if it is not.

benefits.zh: 它們適合指示和工作流程：先核實情況，再清楚說明下一步，常用於電郵、操作指示、安全程序和問題處理。
benefits.en: They are useful for instructions and workflows because they let you check a situation and then state the next action clearly.

benefits.zh: 在後續問題中可以省去完整重複的條件，令問題更簡潔自然。
benefits.en: They make follow-up questions more concise by avoiding repetition of the full condition.

benefits.zh: 它們把不確定情況和適當行動連接起來，提醒讀者不要把未證實的可能性當作事實。
benefits.en: They connect an uncertain situation with an appropriate action and prevent an unverified possibility from being treated as fact.

benefits.zh: 它們可代替 if this is true、if this is the case、if the answer is yes / no 等重複表達，使口語和寫作更自然。
benefits.en: They reduce repetition in speech and writing by replacing expressions such as if this is true, if this is the case, or if the answer is yes or no.
